experiences.name: Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque Exploration
experiences.description: Visit the iconic Hagia Sophia, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that has served as a cathedral, mosque, and museum over 1,500 years. Then walk to the stunning Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque) with its six minarets and exquisite Iznik tile interior. Both sites are within walking distance and offer a profound glimpse into Byzantine and Ottoman history.

experiences.name: Topkapi Palace & Imperial Harem Tour
experiences.description: Explore the opulent Topkapi Palace, the administrative heart of the Ottoman Empire for nearly 400 years. Walk through the Imperial Harem, the Treasury housing the Topkapi Dagger and Spoonmaker's Diamond, and enjoy panoramic views of the Bosphorus. A guided tour brings the sultans' stories vividly to life.

experiences.name: Grand Bazaar & Spice Bazaar Food & Shopping Walk
experiences.description: Wander through the Grand Bazaar, one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets with over 4,000 shops. Then head to the Egyptian Spice Bazaar to sample Turkish delight, dried fruits, saffron, and local spices. Engage with vendors, taste free samples, and soak in centuries of trading culture in a single walk.

experiences.name: Traditional Turkish Breakfast in Karaköy
experiences.description: Indulge in a lavish Turkish breakfast spread (kahvaltı) featuring olives, white cheese, sucuk (spiced sausage), menemen (egg dish), fresh bread, honey, clotted cream, and multiple teas. Karaköy's trendy cafés offer authentic yet atmospheric settings where locals gather on weekend mornings, making it a true cultural ritual.

experiences.name: Bosphorus Sunset Cruise with Street Food Stop
experiences.description: Board a public or private Bosphorus ferry to glide between Europe and Asia, passing Ottoman palaces, ancient fortresses, and waterfront mansions (yalıs). After the cruise, stop at a Karaköy or Eminönü street stall for a classic balık ekmek (grilled fish sandwich) and a glass of ayran, a beloved local street food experience.
